name: omd-browse
description: The web as a command line for Codex: pages become man pages, forms become commands, and the JSON endpoints sites call are learned and replayed with your session. Drives your real Chrome or a separate OMD profile, with handoffs, stored secrets, cross-origin iframes and recording.

interface.shortDescription: Use the web as a command line
interface.longDescription: One `browse` tool takes shell-style command lines. Each page shows an outline, its forms as commands with flags, tables and learned endpoints; actions print only what changed; endpoints the site calls are kept per site and called directly next time. Sign-ins, 2FA and payments are handed to you, and stored secrets are typed without the model seeing them.
defaultPrompt: Open localhost:3000 and check the sign-up form works
